lines.en: label amidorm5:
I knock on the door. I figure that if Ami’s around, she won’t have a problem letting me in.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门。反正 Ami 要是在家，应该不会介意放我进去。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I can’t say the same for Maya. So hopefully-
lines.zh: 可惜，Maya 那边就不好说了。所以但愿——

lines.en: scene firstamidormredux1
Well, I guess this is a thing I have to deal with now.
lines.zh: 好吧，看来这是我眼下必须面对的事了。

lines.en: : What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 你来这干什么？

lines.en: : You realize I sleep in this room, don't you? Are you trying to prevent that from ever happening again?
lines.zh: : 你知道这房间是我睡的吧？你是打算让我以后都睡不成了？

lines.en: : Is Ami around by any chance?
lines.zh: : 请问 Ami 在吗？

lines.en: : Maya? Who’s out there?
lines.zh: : Maya？外面是谁？

lines.en: : No. Ami isn't around right now.
lines.zh: : 不在。Ami 现在不在。

lines.en: : But I just-
lines.zh: : 可是我——

lines.en: : Listen, I'm not letting you inside. So if you could just leave here right away, it would be-
lines.zh: : 听着，我不会让你进来的。所以你要是能马上离开，那就——

lines.en: : Wait, is that Sensei’s voice I hear out there?! Are you turning away my beloved uncle right now?!
lines.zh: : 等等，外面那个是 Sensei 的声音吧？！你居然在把我亲爱的叔叔拒之门外？！

lines.en: scene firstamidormredux2
: Ugh, why does she always have to be so loud?
lines.zh: : 啧，她怎么非得这么大声？

lines.en: : Will you let me in if I promise to not speak to you? Because I really did just come here to see Ami.
lines.zh: : 要是我保证不跟你说话，你放我进去吗？我真的只是来看 Ami 的。

lines.en: scene firstamidormredux1
: Of course you did.
lines.zh: : 你当然「只是」。

lines.en: : You always do.
lines.zh: : 你每次「都只是」。

lines.en: scene black
I'm not quite sure what Maya meant by that last part...but she let me into the room in the end, so I really can't complain.
lines.zh: 我不太懂 Maya 最后那句什么意思……但反正她最后还是放我进来了，我也没什么可抱怨的。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm1
: Sensei! I’m so glad you finally made it! I feel like I've been waiting forever for you to come check out my room.
lines.zh: : Sensei！你可算来了！等你来看我的房间，我简直等了一个世纪！

lines.en: : I’ve been doing a ton of decorating lately. I even went down to the library and made Futaba print out a bunch of pictures for me.
lines.zh: : 我最近布置了好久。我还跑到图书馆，让 Futaba 帮我打印了一大堆图片。

lines.en: : Isn't it super awesome in here? Doesn't it make you want to move in with us?!
lines.zh: : 这里超棒吧？有没有想搬来跟我们一起住？！

lines.en: : Is that a couch over on your side of the room? How did you afford that?
lines.zh: : 你那边那个是沙发？你哪来的钱？

lines.en: scene firstamidorm2
: I didn't. Maya and I found it on the side of the road and called Ayane to help us carry it back.
lines.zh: : 没花钱。我和 Maya 在路边捡的，喊 Ayane 来帮我们抬回来的。

lines.en: : It was super heavy and we almost died.
lines.zh: : 超级重，我们差点死掉。

lines.en: : Correction: I almost died. You didn't even touch the couch.
lines.zh: : 更正：差点死掉的是我。你连沙发的边都没碰。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm3
: What are you talking about? I sat on it before you guys picked it up. That counts as touching, doesn't it?
lines.zh: : 你说什么呢？你们抬起来之前我坐过它。那算碰过吧？

lines.en: : Besides, if I didn't guide you guys up the stairs while you were carrying it, it never would have made it up here.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你们抬着它上楼的时候，要不是我引路，它根本不可能上来。

lines.en: : Whatever, Maya. Stay silent. You know I helped.
lines.zh: : 随便你，Maya。继续沉默吧。你知道我出了力的。

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : You could have just called me, you know. I’m no weightlifter, but I’m pretty sure that I’m stronger than a few teenage girls.
lines.zh: : 你其实直接叫我就行啊。我虽然不是举重选手，但我很确定自己比几个女高中生强壮。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm4
: I tried! But then Maya got all Maya on me and said that she'd never talk to me again if I tried getting you to help as well!
lines.zh: : 我试了！但 Maya 突然 Maya 附体，说我要是敢叫你来帮忙，她就再也不理我！

lines.en: : That seems like a pretty dramatic repercussion for asking someone stronger than you to help you carry something.
lines.zh: : 请个比你强壮的人帮忙抬个东西，代价未免也太戏剧性了。

lines.en: : I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我毫无悔意。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm5
: Anyway, secrets aside, do you wanna hang out with us? It's not like we had any plans, so we can pretty much do whatever you want, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 总之，秘密先放一边，你要跟我们玩吗？我们本来也没安排，你想干什么都行，Sensei。

lines.en: : Sure. That's kind of why I came over here anyway.
lines.zh: : 当然。我本来就是这么想的，才过来的。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm6
: Oh wow, look at the time. I suddenly have to leave.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，瞧瞧都几点了。我突然得走了。

lines.en: : Ugh. Of course you do...
lines.zh: : 啧。你可真是「说走就走」……

lines.en: scene firstamidorm8
Maya quickly gets up and scurries past me into the hall. I try to make eye contact with her on her way out, but she doesn't so much as glance at me.
lines.zh: Maya 迅速起身，从我身边匆匆溜进走廊。我想在她出门时跟她对个眼神，她却连瞥都没瞥我一眼。

lines.en: I still have no idea what her problem with me is, but...I doubt it's one that I can just get to go away overnight.
lines.zh: 我至今不明白她对我的芥蒂到底在哪，不过……这种事恐怕没法一夜之间化解。

lines.en: : Later, Ami. I'll be back once I'm done with the...things I have to do. Or something.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Ami。等我处理完那些……该处理的事就回来。之类的。

lines.en: : Anyway, bye.
lines.zh: : 总之，拜拜。

lines.en: : Yeah...See you later, Maya.
lines.zh: : 嗯……回头见，Maya。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm9
: Sorry about that, Sensei. I guess Maya just...doesn't like you for some reason.
lines.zh: : 刚刚不好意思，Sensei。Maya 她就是……不知道为什么，不太喜欢你。

lines.en: : Woah, really? I had no idea.
lines.zh: : 哇，是吗？完全没看出来。

lines.en: : Anyway, I hope you're okay with it just being the two of us in here.
lines.zh: : 总之，现在屋里就我们两个人，希望你不介意。

lines.en: : Of course I am. That's how it always is at home, isn't it? Well, at least for now.
lines.zh: : 当然不介意。在家里不也总是这样？嗯，至少目前是。

lines.en: : This place is pretty nice, Ami. I wouldn't hold it against you if you just decided to live here full time.
lines.zh: : 这地方挺不错的，Ami。你要是决定干脆常住这儿，我也不会怪你。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm10
: What...What kind of [niece] would I be if I abandoned you to come live here?! There's no way I could leave you alone for that long!
lines.zh: : 什么……我要是为了搬来这里把你抛下，算什么 [niece]？！我怎么可能让你一个人待那么久！

lines.en: : Without me, you’ll starve! And none of your clothes will ever get washed!
lines.zh: : 没有我，你会饿死！你的衣服永远没人洗！

lines.en: : Your life would be in ruin! You need me, Sensei! You need me more than you realize!
lines.zh: : 你的生活会一塌糊涂！你需要我，Sensei！你需要我的程度远超你的想象！

lines.en: : Wow, okay. You don't need to freak out about it. I'm fine with you staying at home. I just didn't think you'd really want to, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好好好，不用这么激动。你待在家里我没意见。我就是没想到你其实真心想留下，大概。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm9
: Of course I want to, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我当然想，Sensei……

lines.en: : There's no place I'd rather be than where the two of us began our life together.
lines.zh: : 没有哪个地方，比我们俩开始共同生活的地方更好。

lines.en: : Well...I'm glad you feel that way. Because my life has gotten pretty convenient thanks to you.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么想我很高兴。毕竟托你的福，我的日子过得相当舒坦。

lines.en: Not like I know how convenient it was before Ami showed up, but that's a different story.
lines.zh: 虽然我也不知道 Ami 出现之前的日子有多舒坦，但那是另一码事了。

lines.en: : I'm glad, Sensei. That's all I could ever really ask for.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴，Sensei。这就是我全部的奢求了。

lines.en: : That said, if you ever need help with anything around your dorm like, you know...lifting a couch, please just let me know.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，要是你在宿舍有什么需要帮忙的，比如说……抬沙发之类的，尽管开口。

lines.en: : If you wind up hurting yourself doing something like that, it will inconvenience me as well. So please be careful.
lines.zh: : 你要是干这种事伤到自己，我也会跟着麻烦的。所以请务必小心。

lines.en: : Heheh...of course.
lines.zh: : 呵呵……知道啦。

lines.en: : And who knows? Maybe Maya will feel a little more comfortable about you coming in here now that you've seen the inside of our room?
lines.zh: : 再说谁知道呢？你现在看过了我们房间的里面，说不定 Maya 以后对你进来就没那么抵触了？

lines.en: Yeah, I don't think that's going to happen.
lines.zh: 是啊，我觉得不会。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm11
: You wanna take a closer look at my stuff, though?! It’s all really cool and is only kinda like my room at home.
lines.zh: : 你想不想仔细看看我的东西？！全都超酷，只有一点点像我在家的房间。

lines.en: : So there are no anime posters or brightly colored manga or stuffed animals?
lines.zh: : 所以说，这里没有动漫海报、没有花花绿绿的漫画、也没有毛绒玩具？

lines.en: : ...Nooooo?
I sigh to myself, not fully understanding both Ami's hobbies and her inability to spot just how similar this is to a room I've already grown accustomed to.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，既没完全搞懂 Ami 的爱好，也没搞懂她为什么看不出这里跟我早已习惯的那间房有多像。

lines.en: : Let’s see what you’ve got, Ami...
lines.zh: : 让我看看你都有什么吧，Ami……

lines.en: : Yay! Attention!
lines.zh: : 耶！要被关注啦！

lines.en: scene firstamidorm12
I take a step to the side and begin to look over Ami’s part of the dorm.
lines.zh: 我侧过一步，开始打量 Ami 的这半边宿舍。

lines.en: Her walls are lined with, as I predicted just moments ago, anime posters and manga.
lines.zh: 她墙上挂满的，正如我几分钟前预言的那样，是动漫海报和漫画。

lines.en: There's a quote from an Emily Dickinson poem on her dry erase board, which is rather surprising given that this is Ami and-
lines.zh: 她的白板上抄着一句 Emily Dickinson 的诗，这可相当出人意料，毕竟她是 Ami，而且——

lines.en: Well, I can't imagine Ami reading anything that doesn't involve romance or...magical girls or something.
lines.zh: 好吧，我实在无法想象 Ami 会读任何不涉及恋爱、或者……魔法少女之类的东西。

lines.en: Suffice it to say, everything looks pretty close to how I imagined it would be.
lines.zh: 总而言之，一切看起来都和我预想的八九不离十。

lines.en: I'm sure that for some girls, a first trip into their room would be kind of like a key to unlocking who they really are or...what they really like.
lines.zh: 我敢说，对某些女孩来说，第一次进她们的房间，就像拿到一把钥匙，能打开她们真实的模样，或者……真实的喜好。

lines.en: But for Ami, it's like I'm using that key to lock myself inside. And I don't know any more about her now than I did even yesterday.
lines.zh: 但对 Ami 来说，倒像是我拿着那把钥匙把自己锁在了里面。我现在对她的了解，甚至不比昨天多。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm13
: So, what do you think? Is it cool? Cause I think it’s cool.
lines.zh: : 那么，你觉得怎么样？酷吧？因为我觉得超酷。

lines.en: : But if you don’t think it’s cool then it’s probably not cool.
lines.zh: : 但你要是觉得不酷，那大概就是不酷了。

lines.en: : Please tell me it's cool.
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我很酷。

lines.en: : It’s cool, Ami. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : 很酷，Ami。别担心。

lines.en: : You have, uhh...a lot more manga than I expected, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你……呃……漫画比我预想的多多了。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm14
: Well, umm...I guess it might be good that...you've forgotten how much you've bought for me?
lines.zh: : 那个……我觉得……你忘了你给我买过多少，说不定还是件好事？

lines.en: : Which isn't to say that I haven't bought any for myself, but...most of it is from you.
lines.zh: : 不是说我自己一本都没买过，但是……大部分都是你买的。

lines.en: : But like, the entire bottom row next to the Sailor Moon poster is all stuff I’ve bought with my own money! So you should...be pretty impressed about that!
lines.zh: : 但 Sailor Moon 海报旁边最下面那一排，全是我用自己零花钱买的！所以你应该……对此相当佩服！

lines.en: : Why exactly would I be impressed about your...ability to purchase books?
lines.zh: : 我到底为什么要佩服你……买书的能力？

lines.en: scene firstamidorm15
: You should be impressed because I’m responsible now! And I know how to manage my money!
lines.zh: : 你应该佩服，因为我现在很有责任感！而且我懂理财了！

lines.en: : That’s great and all, but...where is that money even coming from? Because I don’t give you an allowance.
lines.zh: : 挺好的，不过……你这钱到底哪来的？我可没给你零花钱。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm16
: I’m sorry, Sensei, but I’m afraid that information is classified.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉，Sensei，恐怕这条信息属于机密。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : I can tell you if you really want. But then I'll have to kill you.
lines.zh: : 你真想听我可以告诉你。但之后我就得杀你灭口了。

lines.en: : Just what the hell are you doing in your free time, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你空闲时间到底在干什么，Ami？

lines.en: scene firstamidorm13
: Nothing bad, I promise. You don’t have anything to worry about.
lines.zh: : 没什么坏事，我保证。你没什么可担心的。

lines.en: : You realize that using that line normally just makes people worry even more, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道这句话说出来通常只会让人更担心吧？

lines.en: : Maybe I...want you to worry about me then?
lines.zh: : 那，说不定我……就是想让你担心呢？

lines.en: : Nah. You're old enough to make your own decisions. Probably.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。你已经到了自己做决定的年纪。大概吧。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm17
: I am?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Sure. Why not?
lines.zh: : 当然。不然呢？

lines.en: : So...if I find a stray cat on the side of the road and want to take it home to live with us, I can?
lines.zh: : 那么……我要是在路边捡到一只流浪猫，想带回家跟我们一起住，可以吗？

lines.en: : Well, no. Because that impacts me directly since it is my house. But if you want to take it here, feel free.
lines.zh: : 呃，不行。因为那会直接影响到我，房子是我的。但你要想养在这，请便。

lines.en: : Not that I imagine the dorms allow you to keep pets, but yeah.
lines.zh: : 虽然我想宿舍也不会让你养宠物，随便说说。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm13
: Are you sure, Sensei? What if I let you pick the name?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗，Sensei？要是我让你来取名字呢？

lines.en: : Do you really think something like that would sway me into letting you have a pet?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得这种事能动摇我、让你养宠物？

lines.en: : No. But what do I have to lose beside a cat I don't even have yet?
lines.zh: : 不知道。可我又能损失什么呢？大不了一只我还没有的猫。

lines.en: It's times like this that call for the cop-out answer every legal guardian keeps hidden in their back pocket at all times.
lines.zh: 这种时刻，就该祭出每个监护人永远揣在口袋里的那套万能托词。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 我再想想。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm18
: Yay!
: I promise to help take care of it if you let me get one, okay?
lines.zh: : 你要是让我养，我保证帮忙照顾它，好吗？

lines.en: : Help? You wouldn't be handling all of its care?
lines.zh: : 「帮忙」？难道不是全部由你来照顾？

lines.en: scene firstamidorm17
: All of it? No. I still have school. What if something happened to it while I was gone?
lines.zh: : 全部？不行。我还要上学。我不在的时候它出事了怎么办？

lines.en: : Ami, I am your teacher. I literally walk with you to school.
lines.zh: : Ami，我就是你的老师。上学我可是每天跟你一起走。

lines.en: : That's true. But with how much you've been slacking off lately, do you really have to even come anymore?
lines.zh: : 也是。但你最近翘成那样，你真的还有必要来吗？

lines.en: : You know, that's a fair response. Good job.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话说得有理。干得漂亮。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm13
: So I can get a cat?!
lines.zh: : 所以我可以养猫了？！

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm19
: Why do you hate me so much?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么恨我？！

lines.en: : I don't hate you. I just think that sometimes, you forget how hard my job can be.
lines.zh: : 我不恨你。我只是觉得，你有时候忘了我的工作有多难做。

lines.en: : And even if you are responsible for your age, you're still not at my level yet. You have a little while to go before I let you get some sort of pet.
lines.zh: : 而且就算以你的年纪算得上懂事，你还差我一截。再等一阵子，我才让你养点什么。

lines.en: scene firstamidorm20
: Yeah. I can only imagine how hard it must be to have a bunch of girls who do nothing but love you and try to gain your approval all day.
lines.zh: : 是啊。真不敢想有多难——一群女孩什么都不干，整天爱你、想方设法讨你欢心。

lines.en: : Hey. That comes with its own set of difficulties.
lines.zh: : 喂。这也有它自己的难处的。

lines.en: : Uh-huh...I’m sure it does, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……我相信有的，Sensei……

lines.en: scene black
Eventually, Maya returns and the time comes for me to head out so the two of them can study for whatever standardized tests are coming up soon.
lines.zh: 后来 Maya 回来了，我也该动身了，好让她们俩复习快要到来的什么标准化考试。

lines.en: The thought of staying around to help them with that crosses my mind for a brief moment but, once I really think about it, I'm not even sure if I'd be of any help.
lines.zh: 留下来帮她们复习的念头在我脑中闪过一瞬，但认真一想，我甚至不确定自己帮得上什么忙。

lines.en: It's been a long time since I've brushed up on all things academic and I have no idea if what little knowledge I do still possess is even relevant anymore.
lines.zh: 距离我上次温习课业知识已经过去太久，连我脑子里仅剩的那点存货还过不过时都不知道。

lines.en: As such, I leave the two of them behind and set out toward home, hoping that my decision doesn't cause the two of them to flunk out of school and ruin their lives.
lines.zh: 于是，我把她们俩留在宿舍，动身回家，但愿我的决定不会害得她们双双挂科、毁掉人生。

lines.en: If it does, though, at least Ami will finally have the time to take care of a cat.
lines.zh: 不过真要那样，至少 Ami 总算有时间养猫了。

lines.en: $ ami_love += 1
$ amidorm5 = True
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]！

lines.en: You can now spend time with her in her dorm room!
lines.zh: 现在你可以去她的宿舍房间陪她了！
